core_obligations: Reduce to the affine statement about A[I/a] (proof lines 8577-8580).
Prove that the image of a nonzerodivisor stays a nonzerodivisor (proof lines 8580-8586).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a blowup b : X' -> X in a closed subscheme, the pullback b^{-1}D is defined for every effective Cartier divisor D on X and pullbacks of meromorphic functions are defined for b (source lines 8566-8575). The proof reduces, through the affine description of a blowup and the local characterisation of effective Cartier divisors, to an algebra fact which it then proves in place: for a ring A, an ideal I, a in I and a nonzerodivisor x in A, the image of x in A[I/a] is again a nonzerodivisor, since x(y/a^n) = 0 forces a^m y = 0 and hence y/a^n = 0.
